Info

Pure token scanning engine parsing SCARA DSL text into syntax token spans.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.dsl.syntax.tokenizer.DslSyntaxTokenizer[source]¶

Bases: object

Pure token scanning engine parsing SCARA DSL text into token spans.

It defines:

methods:
tokenize - Scans DSL source text into typed syntax tokens.
get_supported_tags - Returns tuple of supported tag names.
_COMMANDS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({'ACCEL', 'APPROACH', 'ARC_CCW', 'ARC_CW', 'CONFIG', 'CONFIG_ELBOW', 'CONFIG_MOTOR', 'DISABLE', 'ENABLE', 'ESTOP', 'FRAME_RESET', 'FRAME_SET', 'HOLD', 'HOME', 'JOG_AXIS', 'JOG_JOINT', 'JUMP', 'MOVE_J', 'MOVE_L', 'MOVE_PALLET', 'OVERRIDE', 'PALLET_DEF', 'POINT', 'PROBE', 'PUMP', 'RESUME', 'RETRACT', 'SPEED', 'SPLINE', 'SPLINE_BEGIN', 'SPLINE_END', 'SYNC', 'TOOL', 'TOOL_ORIENT', 'VALVE', 'WAIT', 'WAIT_MS', 'ZONE'})¶
_KEYWORDS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({'BLEND', 'DOWN', 'ELBOW', 'FINE', 'FIXED', 'JOINT_LOCKED', 'LEFT', 'OFF', 'ON', 'RAPID', 'RIGHT', 'TANGENTIAL', 'UP', 'WORK'})¶
_RE_NUMBER: Pattern[str] = re.compile('\\b[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+\\b')¶
_RE_PARAM: Pattern[str] = re.compile('\\b([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=')¶
_RE_WORD: Pattern[str] = re.compile('\\b[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\b')¶
_SUPPORTED_TAGS: tuple[str, ...] = ('dsl_comment', 'dsl_command', 'dsl_keyword', 'dsl_param', 'dsl_number')¶
